TicketGraphEdgeRecord.description: One dependency edge of a recorded Ticket graph, as every client sees it.

from_ticket.description: The Ticket that must land first (DR-DE-02).

TicketGraphRecord.description: One Ticket graph proposal as every client sees it: the Spec version it is proposed against, the Tickets and edges it holds, and its lifecycle state.

edges.description: The dependency edges between the Tickets the graph holds, in proposal order.

spec_id.description: The Spec the graph proposes for.

spec_version.description: The Spec content version the graph is proposed against.

tickets.description: Every Ticket the graph holds, in proposal order.

version.description: The aggregate version, for optimistic mutation checks.

TicketGraphState.description: The closed Ticket graph proposal lifecycle on the wire (DR-PS-16, DR-PS-17).

oneOf.description: Recorded against an approved Spec version, awaiting the human approval gate.
Approved; every Ticket in the graph is pinned to the Spec content version the proposal named.

proposals.description: Every proposal recorded against the Spec, oldest first.
